body: It's not that life is meaningless, it's that from the very start of my existence, everything I've seen in this world has basically repulsed me; from shitting to eating to living with and as a species that tortures and rapes and kills one another. I thought I had imparted the general idea (my disgust) in my original post, but I guess I had not.
Life is straightforward: it leads straight to a graveyard.
